title: bouteloua repens
intro: Bouteloua repens, commonly known as Blue Grama Grass, is a perennial grass native to the Great Plains region of North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Bouteloua repens include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents of Bouteloua repens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
